description: Use this when someone gives you a finished blog post, or a translation of one, to save in their blog. Returns the new post's id, title, slug, language and published state; it stays a draft unless published is true. A translation is saved with the original's id as originalArticleId and its own locale. Not for writing a post with AI.

author.description: Author name shown on the post, up to 200 characters

blogId.description: Blog to add the post to

categories.description: Up to 50 category names, each up to 100 characters

content.description: Post body in the chosen format, Markdown or HTML, up to 100,000 characters

description.description: Short summary shown in listings and search results, up to 1,000 characters

format.description: markdown or html; content is treated as HTML when omitted

locale.description: Post language, an ISO 639-1 code such as en or it; required with originalArticleId

originalArticleId.description: Makes this article the `locale` version in an existing article's translation group. It is the original article's id, never a sibling translation's id; absent means a new original.

published.description: true publishes the post on the blog; false or omitted keeps it a draft

slug.description: URL slug such as my-first-post, up to 300 characters

name: create_article
title: Save a blog post
